ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic of an apparatus related to the Miller-Urey experiment; the central circular area is labeled “Primitive Earth Gases” and lists H2O Vapor, NH3, CH4, H2, CO, and other simulated primitive Earth gases; above there is “Electrical Source,” indicating an electric spark/power source; on the left there is H2O Vapor entering, and on the right there is a gas circulation outlet. Then reason: the prompt asks what type of compounds were not detected in the mixture during the experiment, and gives the prompt “such as DNA and RNA.” The text information clearly states that “nucleic acids were not detected in the mixture,” and DNA and RNA both belong to nucleic acids. Therefore, what was not detected was nucleic acid compounds.
